## Motivation

`download_and_cache_file()` wrote streamed responses directly to the final cache path. If a Mooncake trace download failed after partial data had been written, the partial file remained and was treated as a cached dataset on the next load.

Fixes #41244

## Modifications

- Download into a same-directory `.part` file.
- Publish the final cache path with `os.replace()` only after the response is fully written.
- Remove the temporary file when the download fails and preserve any existing final file.
- Add CPU-only regression tests for interrupted downloads, successful downloads, and existing-file preservation.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable. This change does not affect model outputs.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable. This change does not affect inference execution.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit). Pre-commit was installed in WSL, but first-time hook environment initialization timed out; `git diff --check` passed.
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations). No user-facing documentation change is required.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to the [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed) sections. Not applicable to this benchmark download fix.
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Validation

- WSL isolated download tests: passed.
- WSL `compileall`: passed.
- `git diff --check`: passed.
- The full pytest file was blocked during collection because the local WSL environment does not have `triton` installed.

## Review and Merge Process

This PR is ready for maintainer review. CI labels and reruns can be triggered according to the repository contribution guide.

@@ -103,28 +103,45 @@ def download_and_cache_file(url: str, filename: Optional[str] = None):
 
     print(f"Downloading from {url} to {filename}")
 
-    # Stream the response to show the progress bar
-    response = requests.get(url, stream=True)
-    response.raise_for_status()  # Check for request errors
-
-    # Total size of the file in bytes
-    total_size = int(response.headers.get("content-length", 0))

-
-    # Use tqdm to display the progress bar
-    with (
-        open(filename, "wb") as f,
-        tqdm(
-            desc=filename,
-            total=total_size,
-            unit="B",
-            unit_scale=True,
-            unit_divisor=1024,
-        ) as bar,

-        for chunk in response.iter_content(chunk_size=chunk_size):
-            f.write(chunk)
-            bar.update(len(chunk))
+    # Keep incomplete downloads separate from the cache path. A failed
+    # streamed response must not leave a file that a later call mistakes for
+    # a complete cached dataset.
+    temporary_filename = filename + ".part"
+
+    try:
+        # Stream the response to show the progress bar
+        response = requests.get(url, stream=True)
+        response.raise_for_status()  # Check for request errors
+
+        # Total size of the file in bytes
+        total_size = int(response.headers.get("content-length", 0))
+        chunk_size = 1024  # Download in chunks of 1KB
+
+        # Use tqdm to display the progress bar. Publish the final cache path
+        # only after the complete response has been written successfully.
+        with (
+            open(temporary_filename, "wb") as f,
+            tqdm(
+                desc=filename,
+                total=total_size,
+                unit="B",
+                unit_scale=True,
+                unit_divisor=1024,
+            ) as bar,
+        ):
+            for chunk in response.iter_content(chunk_size=chunk_size):
+                if not chunk:
+                    continue
+                f.write(chunk)
+                bar.update(len(chunk))
+
+        os.replace(temporary_filename, filename)
+    except Exception:
+        try:
+            os.remove(temporary_filename)
+        except FileNotFoundError:
+            pass
+        raise
 
     return filename
